text:
Liam: Morning team — noticed a customer prepay (CP-5543) that was invoiced on 03/28 but the committed Dedicated capacity starts 04/15. Billing system put full amount in AR on 03/28 under INV-92211. How do we want to treat revenue cutover for month-end close?
Maya: We need to defer the portion that covers service after 03/31. Recognize only the earned portion for March.
Sofia: Agreed. Can you share the invoice detail and the prepay schedule? Need to know if any upfront platform credits were included.
Liam: Invoice lines pasted: `INV-92211, CP-5543, dedicated_commit_prepay, 60000.00, USD, term: 12m, start_date: 2024-04-15`
Jared: If term starts 4/15 we should book a short-term deferred revenue for 4/15-4/30 pro rata in current close and long-term deferred for the rest if >12 months boundary rules apply. But check our revenue policy cutoffs for prepaid contracts.
Maya: Policy refresher: for prepaid capacity we split deferral between current and future monthly buckets. If >1 year we put long-term, otherwise short-term deferred rev until each month is earned.
Sofia: Also check taxation/withholding impacts — partner billing entity differs. @billing-bot can you pull tax code and payment terms for CP-5543 and link the invoice export?
billing-bot: Exported INV-92211 to s3://redwood-finance-extracts/INV-92211.csv. Tax code: TX-STD, payment_terms: NET30.
Liam: Proposed JEs for March close:
- JE1 (to record receipt): Dr Cash 60k / Cr AR 60k (already posted by billing)
- JE2 (deferral): Dr AR 60k / Cr Deferred_Revenue_SHORT 3k (for 4/15-4/30) / Cr Deferred_Revenue 57k (remaining)
Sofia: That looks right. Please attach amort schedule showing monthly revenue recognition starting 04/15 and a note for revenue audit.
Jared: One more caveat — customer has a promo credit of 5k applied on invoice line 3 (promo_credit). Need to confirm if credit reduces the gross invoice or is a separate liability. If it's a promotional discount, it reduces recognized revenue. If it's a credit note payable, it's a liability.
Liam: Invoice shows `promo_credit, -5000.00` on same invoice. I think it's a discount. I'll mark as reduction to deferred rev.
Maya: Please include FX exposure check. If payment posts in EUR we need to revalue AR/Deferred using month-end FX. Sofia, can you run the FX reval after JEs are posted?
Sofia: Yep. I'll run FX reval and attach the delta to the memo. ETA 16:30 local.
Jared: For sign-off chain — Liam draft memo + JE post, Sofia runs FX and approves technical accounting, Maya gives final sign-off. We need sign-off by 17:30 PT to include in close.
Liam: Drafting memo now, will include: invoice CSV, JE lines, amort table, promo credit rationale, and vendor taxonomy. Ping me if you want to review before I send to Maya.
Maya: Thanks. If we don't get sign-off we'll book a provisional short-term deferral for full invoice and reclass next period — but try to avoid that.
Liam: Noted. Will follow up in thread when memo uploaded. :memo:
